items.description: An iconic Islamic shrine located on the Temple Mount in the Old City of Jerusalem, featuring a distinctive golden dome.
A major Catholic church in Nazareth built over the site traditionally believed to be the home of the Virgin Mary.
facts: Largest Christian sanctuary in the Middle East

items.description: The third holiest site in Islam, this mosque is part of the Al-Aqsa compound in the Old City of Jerusalem.
facts: Located on the southern side of the Temple Mount
Part of the UNESCO World Heritage site

items.description: Israel's official memorial to the victims of the Holocaust, dedicated to preserving the memory of the six million Jews murdered.
facts: Located on the Mount of Remembrance
Houses the world's largest Holocaust archive

items.description: A large park in the Negev Desert known for its striking geological formations and ancient copper mines.
facts: Site of the world's first copper mine
Features an Egyptian temple to Hathor

items.description: A unique marine park in Eilat that allows visitors to observe the Red Sea's coral reefs from a submerged tower.
facts: Located at the Coral Beach Nature Reserve
Observatory sits 6 meters below sea level
First underwater observatory in the world

items.description: A historic hill located just outside the walls of the Old City of Jerusalem, home to several important religious sites.
facts: Site of the Room of the Last Supper

items.description: The world's largest erosion crater, located in the Negev Desert and offering spectacular desert landscapes.
facts: Measures 40 km long and up to 10 km wide
Forms part of the Ramon Nature Reserve
Geological window into ancient rock layers

items.description: A national park featuring thousands of man-made caves, including the famous bell-shaped caverns used since antiquity.
facts: Contains the ruins of ancient Maresha
Known as the land of a thousand caves

items.description: A culturally and religiously significant river that flows through the Jordan Rift Valley into the Dead Sea.
facts: Primary water source for the Sea of Galilee

items.description: An oasis and nature reserve on the western shore of the Dead Sea, famous for its waterfalls and diverse wildlife.
facts: Largest oasis along the Dead Sea
Home to herds of Nubian ibex
Mentioned several times in the Bible

items.description: A nature reserve in the Golan Heights characterized by deep basalt canyons, streams, and natural swimming pools.
facts: Home to the Yehudiya and Zavitan streams
